name: What is the typical process for new room construction with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for new room construction with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. We then proceed with design and architectural planning, ensuring all local regulations in Berkeley, Oakland, or other East Bay areas are met. Following permit acquisition, our skilled team handles the construction, keeping you updated throughout. Finally, we conduct a thorough walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction with your new space.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design and planning, permit acquisition, construction, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
